//go:build ignore

// Run only with the explicitly approved T3.13 budget. Keys are loaded by an
// external wrapper; this tool records responses, never headers or requests.
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"github.com/nrynss/before-yes/internal/appstore"
	"github.com/nrynss/before-yes/internal/checklist"
	"github.com/nrynss/before-yes/internal/model"
	"github.com/nrynss/before-yes/internal/pipeline"
	"github.com/nrynss/before-yes/internal/spend"
	"github.com/nrynss/before-yes/internal/tavily"
)

const root = "testdata/alternatives/nano"
const db = "/tmp/t313-nano-live/spend.db"

func save(path string, v any) {
	b, e := json.MarshalIndent(v, "", "  ")
	must(e)
	must(os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0700))
	must(os.WriteFile(path, append(b, '\n'), 0600))
}
func must(err error) {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}

type responseTransport struct {
	base http.RoundTripper
	mu   sync.Mutex
	n    int
	dir  string
}

func (t *responseTransport) RoundTrip(req *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
	resp, err := t.base.RoundTrip(req)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	b, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	resp.Body.Close()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	resp.Body = io.NopCloser(bytes.NewReader(b))
	t.mu.Lock()
	defer t.mu.Unlock()
	t.n++
	// The kind and status are safe association metadata. No request query,
	// body or headers are persisted, including for failed responses.
	kind := "other"
	switch {
	case strings.Contains(req.URL.Host, "tokenfactory"):
		kind = "model"
	case strings.Contains(req.URL.Host, "tavily"):
		kind = "tavily"
	case strings.Contains(req.URL.Path, "/search"):
		kind = "store-search"
	default:
		kind = "store-reviews"
	}
	filename := fmt.Sprintf("%04d-%s-%d.json", t.n, kind, resp.StatusCode)
	must(os.MkdirAll(t.dir, 0700))
	must(os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(t.dir, filename), b, 0600))
	return resp, nil
}

type searchRecorder struct {
	pipeline.Searcher
	mu    sync.Mutex
	dir   string
	n     int
	pages map[string]tavily.Result
}

func (s *searchRecorder) Search(ctx context.Context, q tavily.Search) ([]tavily.Result, tavily.Credits, error) {
	hits, c, e := s.Searcher.Search(ctx, q)
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	s.n++
	save(filepath.Join(s.dir, fmt.Sprintf("search-%02d.json", s.n)), struct {
		Results []tavily.Result
		Credits tavily.Credits
	}{hits, c})
	for _, h := range hits {
		if _, exists := s.pages[h.URL]; !exists {
			s.pages[h.URL] = h
		}
	}
	return hits, c, e
}

type nanoRecord struct {
	SourceURL string
	Page      tavily.Result
	Reply     model.Reply
}
type readerRecorder struct {
	pipeline.Chatter
	search *searchRecorder
	mu     sync.Mutex
	dir    string
	n      int
}

func (r *readerRecorder) Chat(ctx context.Context, msgs []model.Message, o model.Options) (model.Reply, error) {
	reply, e := r.Chatter.Chat(ctx, msgs, o)
	user := msgs[len(msgs)-1].Content
	if strings.HasPrefix(user, "Original title:") {
		_, tail, _ := strings.Cut(user, "Source URL: ")
		url, _, _ := strings.Cut(tail, "\n")
		r.search.mu.Lock()
		page := r.search.pages[url]
		r.search.mu.Unlock()
		r.mu.Lock()
		r.n++
		save(filepath.Join(r.dir, fmt.Sprintf("nano-%02d.json", r.n)), nanoRecord{url, page, reply})
		r.mu.Unlock()
	}
	return reply, e
}

type lookupRecord struct {
	Name string
	Apps []appstore.App
}
type storeRecorder struct {
	*appstore.Client
	mu  sync.Mutex
	dir string
	n   int
}

func (s *storeRecorder) Storefront() string { return s.Country }
func (s *storeRecorder) Find(ctx context.Context, name string, limit int) ([]appstore.App, error) {
	apps, e := s.Client.Find(ctx, name, limit)
	s.mu.Lock()
	s.n++
	save(filepath.Join(s.dir, fmt.Sprintf("lookup-%02d.json", s.n)), lookupRecord{name, apps})
	s.mu.Unlock()
	return apps, e
}

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) != 2 || (os.Args[1] != "capture" && os.Args[1] != "live") {
		panic("choose capture or live")
	}
	mode := os.Args[1]
	ctx := context.Background()
	must(os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(db), 0700))
	meter, e := spend.Open(ctx, spend.Config{Path: db, ReservationTTL: 30 * time.Minute, Pools: map[spend.Pool]spend.PoolConfig{
		spend.PoolModel: {Limit: 676237000}, spend.PoolTavily: {Limit: 84 * spend.CreditUnit}, spend.PoolChecksDaily: {Limit: 5},
	}})
	must(e)
	defer meter.Close()
	// The isolated DB is reused across captures and the single live request.
	// Baseline old work: $0.323763 and66 credits; revised task totals <=$1/150.
	defer func() {
		m, _ := meter.Status(ctx, spend.PoolModel)
		t, _ := meter.Status(ctx, spend.PoolTavily)
		v := map[string]any{"old_model_nano": 323763000, "old_tavily_credits": 66, "revised_model": m, "revised_tavily": t, "db": db}
		save(filepath.Join(root, mode+"-spend.json"), v)
		fmt.Printf("model_new=$%.6f tavily_new=%.3f cumulative_model=$%.6f cumulative_tavily=%.3f\n", float64(m.Spent)/1e9, float64(t.Spent)/float64(spend.CreditUnit), float64(m.Spent+323763000)/1e9, 66+float64(t.Spent)/float64(spend.CreditUnit))
	}()
	key := func() (string, error) {
		v := os.Getenv("NEBIUS_KEY")
		if v == "" {
			return "", fmt.Errorf("missing model key")
		}
		return v, nil
	}
	settings := model.Settings{Provider: "tokenfactory", BaseURL: "https://api.tokenfactory.nebius.com/v1", Model: "nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B", InputPerM: .06, OutputPerM: .24, MaxTokens: 8192, PerMinute: 100, Extra: map[string]any{"chat_template_kwargs": map[string]any{"enable_thinking": false}}}
	reader, e := model.New(settings, key)
	must(e)
	js := settings
	js.Model = "nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b"
	js.InputPerM = .30
	js.OutputPerM = .90
	js.MaxTokens = 4096
	js.PerMinute = 300
	judge, e := model.New(js, key)
	must(e)
	titles := []struct {
		Slug, Title string
		Age         int
	}{{"roblox", "Roblox", 9}, {"minecraft", "Minecraft", 9}, {"khan-academy-kids", "Khan Academy Kids", 5}}
	if mode == "live" {
		titles = titles[:1]
	}
	transport := http.DefaultTransport
	for _, title := range titles {
		dir := filepath.Join(root, title.Slug)
		if mode == "live" {
			dir = filepath.Join(root, "live-roblox")
		}
		if _, e := os.Stat(dir); e == nil {
			panic("refuse overwrite existing capture: " + dir)
		}
		must(os.MkdirAll(dir, 0700))
		http.DefaultTransport = &responseTransport{base: transport, dir: filepath.Join(dir, "responses")}
		search := &searchRecorder{Searcher: tavily.New("", func() (string, error) {
			v := os.Getenv("TAVILY_KEY")
			if v == "" {
				return "", fmt.Errorf("missing Tavily key")
			}
			return v, nil
		}), dir: dir, pages: map[string]tavily.Result{}}
		store := &storeRecorder{Client: appstore.New("", "us"), dir: dir}
		rr := &readerRecorder{Chatter: reader, search: search, dir: dir}
		p := &pipeline.Pipeline{Gatherer: &pipeline.Gatherer{Store: store, Search: search, Meter: meter}, Reader: &pipeline.Reader{Model: rr, Meter: meter}, Judge: &pipeline.Judge{Model: judge, Meter: meter, Fast: map[string]any{"chat_template_kwargs": map[string]any{"enable_thinking": false}}, Think: map[string]any{"chat_template_kwargs": map[string]any{"enable_thinking": true}}}, Cache: &pipeline.MemCache{}, Checks: meter}
		if mode == "capture" {
			apps, e := store.Find(ctx, title.Title, 5)
			must(e)
			var app *appstore.App
			for i := range apps {
				if strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(apps[i].Name), strings.ToLower(title.Title)) {
					app = &apps[i]
					break
				}
			}
			if app == nil {
				panic("no original App Store match")
			}
			card := pipeline.Card{Title: title.Title, Age: title.Age, Kind: pipeline.KindIOS, Verdict: checklist.No, App: &pipeline.AppInfo{TrackID: app.ID, Name: app.Name, Genre: app.Genre}}
			// Discovery's no is a request fixture, not evidence of a computed verdict.
			alts, e := p.FindAlternatives(ctx, card, "capture-"+title.Slug)
			must(e)
			save(filepath.Join(dir, "pending.json"), alts)
			fmt.Printf("capture %s: %d confirmed names, %d Nano pages\n", title.Slug, len(alts), rr.n)
		} else {
			card, e := p.Run(ctx, pipeline.Request{Title: title.Title, Age: title.Age}, "live-roblox")
			must(e)
			save(filepath.Join(dir, "main-card-before-alternatives.json"), card)
			final, alts, e := p.WithAlternatives(ctx, card, "live-roblox")
			must(e)
			save(filepath.Join(dir, "card.json"), final)
			save(filepath.Join(dir, "alternative-cards.json"), alts)
			fmt.Printf("live %s: %s, %d checked alternatives\n", title.Slug, final.Verdict, len(final.Alternatives))
		}
	}
}
